title: Power V15
author: Matthew Noel
desc:
Power V15 is a 12-week minimalist hybrid strength program designed to build high-level strength and an athletic physique while preserving the recovery needed for running, HIIT, and occupational performance.

The program prioritizes weighted chin-ups, weighted dips, bench press, and deadlift, with targeted shoulder and biceps work to develop a stronger V-taper. Low volume, high-quality sets, and frequent short sessions keep fatigue controlled while allowing strength and conditioning to progress together.

The standard:
315 Bench • +50 × 5 Chin • +120 × 5 Dip • 405 Deadlift • Faster Runs

15 minutes is the target. Performance is the outcome.
